description: This file defines the CompoundTypeAliasTree class, which implements a prefix tree (trie) data structure for managing compound type aliases within the Orleans serialization type system. It includes methods for creating the tree, adding nodes with keys and optional values, and retrieving child nodes.

classes.name: CompoundTypeAliasTree
classes.description: Represents a prefix tree (trie) for managing compound type aliases, supporting node addition and retrieval based on keys and associated types.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new root node of the tree with no key or value.

methods.name: GetChildOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a child node associated with the specified key, or null if none exists.

methods.name: TryGetChild
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a child node for the given key, returning true if found.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new node with a key (string or Type) to the tree, optionally with an associated Type value.
